I'd like to hear from both the projection supervisor and the safety and insurance coordinator on whether they see any issues with this setup.

I checked the distributor portal this morning, and the KDM we have is authorized only for Hall B's secure projector — not Hall A. It also includes a no-camera-capture condition that applies to both the screening and the Q&A. This update came in after the technical run sheet was circulated, so the draft we're reviewing doesn't reflect these constraints. We cannot run the feature in Hall A with this KDM, and we cannot record the Q&A under the no-camera-capture condition.

transcript.text: I need to add a critical safety and insurance constraint to what Leila just raised. I received the signed fire-marshal certificate after the morning operations meeting, and I haven't attached it to the venue file yet. The certificate caps Hall B at exactly 140 audience members because one exit is under repair. Additionally, the insurer requires a filed crowd-flow plan specifying one-way entry before admission. So if we're forced to move the screening to Hall B due to the KDM issue Leila identified, we cannot simply carry over the 180-person capacity or the ordinary two-way audience movement from the draft run sheet — both would violate the fire-marshal cap and the insurer's requirements.
